dedupe_keys.name: data center map colocation cloud and connectivity directory

description: Data Center Map is a long-running online directory of data centres, colocation providers, cloud platforms and connectivity services, used widely by the industry to find facilities by country, city and operator. According to its own site it currently lists 12,259 data centres in 179 countries. Each facility page gives the operator, address and a map location, and for many sites details such as floor space, power capacity, certifications, connectivity options and carriers present, with links to nearby internet exchanges; the site also covers planned and under-construction facilities and publishes market overviews by metro area. Browsing the directory and map is free, while bulk data exports and analysis tools are sold as paid products. Coverage: worldwide, continuously updated from operator submissions and research. Format and access: free web directory and map; paid data exports under commercial terms. Caveats: content is supplied partly by operators and is uneven between countries; no open licence, so the data cannot be redistributed. Simulation uses: locating facilities for hazard exposure, mapping metro clusters and planned capacity for scenario studies, and linking data centres to network and power infrastructure. Related records: Cloudscene is a comparable commercial directory, ATLAS and the IM3 atlas are open alternatives, and PeeringDB lists facilities with interconnection data.
